about_story_text: Founded in 2010, the International Society of Major Works (SIGAT) specializes in executing public works and hydraulic infrastructure projects. Based in Le Bardo, Tunisia, our team of highly qualified experts is committed to providing services that combine technical expertise with respect for environmental standards.
about_mission_text: To deliver precise execution of hydraulic and public works in Tunisia, strictly respecting deadlines, budgets, and the highest safety standards.
about_vision_text: To become the reference execution partner in Tunisia for major construction groups, recognized for our mastery of water and sanitation networks.

legal_liability: The information published is indicative. SIGAT strives to keep it up to date but cannot guarantee it is free of errors; it does not constitute a contractual offer.
legal_privacy_intro: SIGAT complies with Tunisian Organic Law No. 2004-63 of 27 July 2004 on the protection of personal data. This policy explains what data we receive through this site and what we do with it.
legal_pv_who: SIGAT – Société Internationale des Grands Travaux, Le Bardo, Tunisia.
legal_pv_data: Only what you enter in the contact form: name, job title, company, e-mail, phone, message and, for applicants, the link to your CV. No data is collected without your knowledge.
legal_pv_why: Answering your request, consulting you for projects, managing our supplier and subcontractor list, and reviewing applications. Your data is never sold or used for advertising.
legal_pv_keep: Business and partnership requests: 3 years after the last contact. Applications: 2 years. You can ask for deletion at any time.
legal_pv_share: Only the SIGAT departments concerned by your request, and our e-mail provider for delivering messages.
legal_pv_rights: You have the right to access, correct and object to the processing of your data. You may also refer to the National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data (INPDP).
legal_pv_exercise: To exercise your rights, write to
legal_cookies: This site uses no advertising cookies and no audience measurement. It loads fonts and map tiles from third-party services, which receive your IP address in doing so. Your language choice stays in your browser only.
